notes.title: Steam Next Fest is over & Roadmap check!
notes.content: [h2][b]Steam Next Fest is over, thank you all![/b][/h2][p] The festival has come to an end, and the results for [i]Out of the Shadows[/i] are incredibly positive. Your feedback and enthusiasm are a huge motivation as we move forward with development.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Some key numbers[/b][/h3][p] 🕹️ Demo downloads: 4,068 👥 Unique players who launched the game: 2,230[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Player breakdown:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]20% from Asia[/p][/*][*][p]13% from the US[/p][/*][*][p]10% from France[/p][/*][*][p]Over 35% from Europe overall[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What we’ve learned[/b][/h3][p] Next Fest was a real success for us. Community feedback helped us identify two major areas for improvement:[/p][p][b]Accessibility[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clearer & more clues[/p][/*][*][p]In-game help systems to assist with puzzle solving[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Horror & Atmosphere[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stronger emphasis on immersion and tension in upcoming levels[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Roadmap[/b][/h2][p] 🗓️ Late June: Start of internal playtests to finalize Map 1 🛠️ July: Development of Map 2 begins 🚀 Full release planned: Q4 2025[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks again for all your support![/b][/p]

notes.title: We're taking part in the Steam Next fest!
notes.content: [h3]We're excited to announce that we're part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]Jump into our [b]multiplayer demo[/b], now live on Steam, play solo or team up with up to [b]4 players[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t miss your chance to experience the game early. [/p][p]Check it out and let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][p]We have so much more in stock for the full release ! A couple of maps, more dynamic & unique gameplay features, asymmetric gameplay as well..! [/p][p][/p][p]If you have an idea or want to share feedback, please reach out on our socials, we will be glad to hear from you ![/p]
